tools.name: i22_ai_company_facts
tools.description: Returns the facts table of i22 from the about page, one label and value per row. Use it for questions about i22 as a company, such as founding, location, size, management or ownership.

tools.name: i22_ai_services_list
tools.description: Lists the services of i22 with name, URL and definition sentence; a service without definition shows its teaser, labelled as short description. Use it to see what i22 offers before asking for details with i22_ai_service_get.

tools.name: i22_ai_service_get
tools.description: Returns one service of i22 with headline, intro, definition, building blocks, why i22, related case studies and the contact mailbox with people and roles. Use it once you know which service a question is about.

tools.name: i22_ai_cases_find
tools.description: Finds case studies of i22, optionally filtered by service, customer and free text; each with title, customer, service, in use since and teaser where the page has one. Use it for references and examples. The content has no industry field: for an industry, filter by customer or put the industry in que

tools.name: i22_ai_contacts_for_topic
tools.description: Names the contacts of i22 for a topic with role and e-mail address. Topics: new_project, career, press, general, or the slug of a service from i22_ai_services_list. Use it when someone wants to reach i22.

tools.name: i22_ai_site_search
tools.description: Full-text search over the published pages of the i22 website. Returns matching pages with title, URL and short description. Terms are OR-linked; use a few precise words (at most 200 characters). Read a hit with i22_ai_page_read before answering from it. Retrieval needs no personal data; do not inclu

tools.name: i22_ai_page_read
tools.description: Returns the text of one published page of the i22 website. Pass the path (e.g. /leistungen) or the full URL from an i22_ai_site_search or i22_ai_page_list result.

tools.name: i22_ai_page_list
tools.description: Lists the published pages of the i22 website in one language with title, URL and description. Use it to get an overview; prefer i22_ai_site_search for specific questions.

tools.name: i22_ai_inquiry_preview
tools.description: Step 1 of 2 for sending an inquiry to the responsible i22 team on behalf of the person you are helping. Sends nothing: returns a summary and a confirmation token. Show the person the summary, and call i22_ai_inquiry_send only after they confirm it. All fields come from the person; never invent them.

tools.name: i22_ai_inquiry_send
tools.description: Step 2 of 2: sends the inquiry from i22_ai_inquiry_preview by e-mail to the responsible i22 team. Call it only after the person has confirmed the summary. The same inquiry is sent at most once within 24 hours, and the number of inquiries per sender and per day is limited.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "i22_ai_site_search" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: i22_ai_services_list, i22_ai_site_search, i22_ai_page_read, i22_ai_page_list · Private data: i22_ai_service_get, i22_ai_contacts_for_topic, i22_ai_inquiry_preview · Public sink: i22_ai_inquiry_send.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: i22_ai_services_list, i22_ai_site_search, i22_ai_page_read, i22_ai_page_list · Private data: i22_ai_service_get, i22_ai_contacts_for_topic, i22_ai_inquiry_preview · Public sink: i22_ai_inquiry_send

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
